observation_unit: Individual sampled high-school senior responding to one questionnaire form (P1 pp.9–10, Method).
sampling_unit: Article: high schools and students in a multistage random sample (P1 p.9). Supplied source description adds geographic PSUs, schools and students/classrooms; exact design identifiers are not supplied.
assignment_unit: No randomized assignment to cohort or survey year. Questionnaire forms are distributed within schools according to the source description; forms are measurement subsamples, not treatments (P1 p.10; source_description.md, Questionnaire-form design).
clusters: School/PSU clustering is part of sampling; number of clusters, strata and identifiers are unavailable in the public dictionaries. Repeated surveys are separate respondent cross-sections. No empirical overlap or clustering adjustment is established (P1 p.9; source_description.md, Sampling design/Identifiers).
native_se_method_software: LISREL 8.7 for CFA (P1 p.10), with LISREL SEs used for latent mean confidence intervals (P1 p.15). Fitting function, information matrix, robust/survey correction and item-test software/df are not stated.
first_stage_strength: Not applicable: no instrumental-variable model or first-stage regression (P1 pp.10,14–15).
